name: A-kun
source:
The only first-year in the group.
While he claims he's easily scared, when faced with scary phenomena, it doesn't really bother him and he laughs it off, making him thoroughly unsuited for horror stories.
He likes cats, the Shinkansen and Kumoha-type trains.
